## Project Context

This is a Vue 3 note application built with Nuxt and TypeScript. The project uses:

-   Vue 3.5+ with Composition API
-   Nuxt ui 4 as UI framework
-   Vueuse 13.x+ as the utility library
-   TypeScript 5.8+ for type safety
-   TipTap 3 for rich text editing

## Coding Standards

-   Follow TypeScript best practices with proper type definitions
-   Use Vue 3 Composition API with `<script setup>` syntax
-   Use async/await for asynchronous operations
-   Ensure proper error handling with try/catch blocks

## UI/UX Guidelines

-   Follow Nuxt ui component design patterns
-   Ensure responsive design for all components
-   use Nuxt Ui mcp server
